description: Tool to update custom messages for form UI elements like buttons, errors, and placeholders in Typeform. Use when you need to customize the text displayed to form respondents.

block_short_text_placeholder.description: Placeholder text for short text input fields (max 100 characters).
block_short_text_placeholder.title: Block Short Text Placeholder

label_button_hint_default.description: Tooltip text for the continue button (max 28 characters). Use this to provide hints about the button's function.
label_button_hint_default.title: Label Button Hint Default

label_button_no_answer_default.description: Text for the 'Continue without answering' button (max 100 characters). Shown when a question is optional.
label_button_no_answer_default.title: Label Button No Answer Default

label_button_submit.description: Text for the submit button (max 100 characters). This is the final button to submit the form.
label_button_submit.title: Label Button Submit

label_error_required.description: Error message shown when a required field is empty (max 64 characters).
label_error_required.title: Label Error Required

name: update_form_messages

message.description: Success message describing the operation result.
message.title: Message

success.description: Whether the messages were successfully updated. Always true if no error was raised.
success.title: Success
